1. na pagina de dashboard quando abre ela ela não inicia do topo da pagina, pode corrigir isso?
2. quando abro o cartão pop up (no mobile) do pedido do cliente ele corta um pouco do botão "arquivar" pode corrigir o pop up, inclusive pode deixar ele até como uma pagina completa no mobile

**Considering Accessibility Fixes**

I'm currently focused on the dashboard's scrolling behavior, specifically the Admin view. The existing design doesn't auto-scroll to the top upon opening, which could impact user experience and accessibility. To fix this, I'm thinking of adding a scroll-to-top feature on page load. Furthermore, I've identified that the "Order Detail Modal" lacks focus-trapping, and is not properly accessible.


**Reviewing Modal Display**

I'm now diving into the mobile display of the "Order Detail Modal". The "Archive" button gets cut off, so I'm thinking a full-page view on mobile would be the best solution. I'm also looking at the codebase and the tech stack, which is React with Tailwind CSS and Firebase. The structure is clear, with `AdminPage`, `DashboardView`, and `OrdersView` working together with the modal. I'm going to start implementing the fix soon, using a `useEffect` hook to force scroll to the top for the initial screen.


**Adjusting Scrolling Logic**

I'm now revising my approach to the scrolling issue. Adding `handleNavClick` directly to `DashboardView.tsx` seems more targeted. I'm also reviewing `AdminPage.tsx`. It looks like the main content area, with the overflow, is the one needing the scroll reset. I need a `useRef` pointing to the main container and adjust my scroll logic to target it when the `activeView` changes. It seems I made a slight error in my first guess; it's the `main` tag with `overflow-y-auto` that needs focus. I have to adapt `window.scrollTo` to this particular implementation.


**Finalizing Mobile Modal**

I'm implementing a full-screen mobile modal. The approach involves making it a fixed container spanning the viewport, with a flex column layout. The header, with a back arrow, will stay fixed at the top, and the footer will be fixed at the bottom. The main content will scroll. I'm focusing on ensuring the z-index is high enough to avoid overlap. I'm modifying the CSS classes of `OrderDetailModal` for this. Specifically, I'm working on the `fixed inset-0` layout and flex column structure. I'm also addressing the footer's `safe-area-bottom` on iOS.


**Adapting Scroll Reset**

I'm now revising my scroll reset logic. I've added a `useRef` to the `<main>` content area within `AdminPage.tsx` and implemented a `useEffect` hook that triggers when `activeView` changes. This ensures the main content area scrolls to the top. I'm also updating `OrderDetailModal.tsx`, modifying the container classes for full-screen display on mobile to improve readability.


**Completing Modal Adjustments**

I've just added the crucial modifications to `OrderDetailModal.tsx`. I've made the modal truly full-screen on mobile now, adjusting the height and width to fill the viewport and updating the padding to `p-0`.  I've made the necessary changes to ensure the header's rounded corners are preserved on larger screens, making it `sm:rounded-t-xl`. The flex layout is now handling the header, main content, and footer correctly, even on the smallest screens.

Aqui estão as alterações solicitadas.

1.  **Dashboard/Admin Scroll:** Atualizei o `AdminPage.tsx`. Como o conteúdo do admin rola dentro de um container específico (e não na janela principal do navegador), adicionei uma referência (`ref`) a esse container para forçar a rolagem para o topo (scrollTop = 0) sempre que você trocar de aba no menu lateral.
2.  **Detalhes do Pedido (Mobile):** Atualizei o `OrderDetailModal.tsx`. Agora, em telas pequenas (mobile), o modal ocupa 100% da altura e largura da tela (estilo "página completa"), garantindo que o cabeçalho fique fixo no topo e os botões de ação fiquem fixos no rodapé, com a área de conteúdo rolando no meio. Isso resolve o problema de cortar botões. Em telas maiores (tablet/desktop), ele continua sendo um modal centralizado.

entries.description: Add scroll-to-top behavior when switching admin views by referencing the scrollable container.
Make the modal full-screen on mobile to prevent cutting off content and improve usability.
